claim: Each replacement edits only the authoritative linked lambda-source definition D to D'. Hosts, generic machines, the upper RML workload and requests stay unchanged.

replacements.definition: MATCH: a repeated pattern variable already bound to a value
replacements.description: D compares the earlier binding with the candidate; D' keeps the earlier bindings without comparing.
D prepends each substituted head; D' appends it after the substituted tail.

replacements.definition: SELECT_NAMED_RULE: what happens after a rule matches and its replacement is substituted
replacements.description: D applies the first matching rule; D' applies a later applicable rule when one exists and falls back to the current rule.

replacements.definition: FIND_REBINDING: how an imported definition's name is rebound
replacements.description: D maps a rebinding's source name to its target; D' swaps the two binder roles, so lookup maps target to source.
D returns a proof only for an equal known judgement; D' returns the first known proof without comparing.
